data.title: 苍崎青子 · 泳道边的计时器
data.description: 训练馆里只剩一条泳道还有水纹。青子把计时器按停，抬手甩开睫毛上的水珠。运动巾垂在肩上，水珠沿着泳衣的红边一路滑到瓷砖。
data.location: 室内游泳馆的泳道尽头
data.action: 站在岸边按停计时器，肩上搭着运动巾
data.lighting: 高窗的白光印在泳道和泳池瓷砖上
data.camera: 与人物平视的中景，泳道在背后
data.mood: 认真回看这一趟的成绩
data.promptProse: Aoko stops a handheld timer at the end of an indoor lap pool, a quick-dry towel looped around her neck. A row of drops runs along the cobalt-and-crimson racing suit and its white contour piping. Pool lanes recede toward the high windows.
data.animaCaption: Her wet thumb presses the timer while the empty lane is still rippling behind her.
